all-seeing-male.description: a slim young prophet who sees every fate, a young man with light skin, long straight silver-white hair hanging straight down his back at rest, not flying, a youthful handsome clean-shaven face, no beard, eyes glowing gold, a small thin golden ring of light close behind the head, no wider than the shoulders, long robes of black and gold covered with small golden embroidered eyes, a large golden eye on the chest, a long black and gold cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, no staff, no flying pages, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

all-seeing-female.description: a young prophetess who sees every fate, a young woman with light skin, long golden hair lying flat on her back and the cloak, hanging straight down at rest, not flying, not swinging, not blowing back, eyes glowing gold, a golden crown, a golden ring of light with runes close behind the head, no wider than the shoulders, long robes of black and gold covered with small golden embroidered eyes, a large golden eye on the chest, a long black and gold cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, a beautiful calm young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no staff, no flying pages, no cards, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

soul-lord-male.description: a tall reaper lord in a deep black hood of smoke, the face hidden behind a silver mask shaped like a skull with glowing crimson eyes, black armour with white bone plates shaped like ribs on the chest, spiked bone pauldrons, a dark belt, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black boots with pale bone knee guards, no spirit lights, no ghosts, no scythes, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

soul-lord-female.description: a slim reaper lady in a deep black hood of smoke, a few strands of dark red-brown hair, the face hidden behind a silver mask shaped like a skull with glowing crimson eyes, black armour with white bone plates shaped like ribs on the chest, spiked bone pauldrons, a dark belt, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black boots with pale bone knee guards, no spirit lights, no ghosts, no scythes, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

navia-emperor-male.description: the deathless god-emperor of the underworld, a gaunt man with very pale grey skin, sunken cheeks, a skull-like face, eyes glowing cold blue, a tall crown of black iron spikes, armour of black iron and bone with a ribcage of white bone on the chest, a skull on the shoulder, a long mantle of black smoke with small pale blue soul sparks hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, bone and iron greaves, no spectral hands, no lantern sceptre, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

navia-emperor-female.description: the deathless god-empress of the underworld, a woman with a slim feminine figure, very pale grey skin, long straight black hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing cold blue, a tall crown of icy blue soul fire spikes, armour of dark steel and black iron with glowing pale blue edges, a long black cloak with small pale blue soul sparks hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, dark steel greaves and boots, a beautiful gaunt young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no spectral hands, no lantern sceptre, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

dark-king-male.description: the king of a night without stars, a young man with pale skin, long silver-white hair hanging straight down his back at rest, not flying, a sharp elegant face, eyes glowing violet, a tall crown of black thorns, a black eclipse disk with a thin silver rim close behind the head, black armour with glowing silver-white lines, huge black feathered wings of shadow folded close behind the back, a long black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black boots, no daggers, the wings staying folded close behind the back, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing

dark-king-female.description: the queen of a night without stars, a young woman with a slim feminine figure, pale skin, very long silver-white hair hanging straight down her back at rest, not flying, eyes glowing violet, a tall crown of black thorns, a black eclipse disk with a thin silver rim close behind the head, black armour with glowing silver-white lines, huge black feathered wings of shadow folded close behind the back, a long black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black heeled boots, a beautiful young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no daggers, the wings staying folded close behind the back, walking with both arms swinging naturally at the sides, the hands empty and loosely closed, holding nothing
